get.description:
Full structural analysis of the stored crawl (spec §37 sections).

VIDEO LENS: network statistics, community structure (modularity,
conductance, internal/external ratio), reinforcement (WCR + seeded
degree-preserving null model with z-score/percentile, community
persistence), centrality (PageRank/HITS). CHANNEL LENS: channel
projection network + concentration (HHI/top share). Every metric
carries the §36 metadata envelope; unavailable metrics are explicit,
never silent zeros. Includes verbatim research disclaimers (§38).

Audience/commenter lens (§22): mean Jaccard commenter overlap within
vs between detected communities. Unavailable when no comment identities
were collected - missing data is never converted to zero.

get.description: The frontier of a layer (drives the UI layer stepper).
Aggregate statistics for the whole recommendation network (or a run).

Enriched node/edge payload for the interactive graph UI.

Nodes carry composite labels (``[ID] + Channel Name + Video Title +
thumbnails/metrics``) plus degree/kind/provenance; the response includes
run and channel facets so the filter bar never derives options from the
rendered graph. ``projection=channel`` collapses the video network into
a channel-level graph (channels as nodes, weighted edges between them).

Advanced selection:
- ``layer_index`` limits the slice to one crawl layer.
- ``connected=only`` keeps nodes that participate in at least one edge;
  ``connected=isolated`` keeps only isolated nodes (they render detached).
- ``scraped=scraped`` keeps only nodes whose recommendation feed has been
  scraped; ``scraped=unscraped`` keeps only nodes never scraped (the
  candidates for a next expansion).

get.description:
Full research-grade centrality battery for the rendered graph slice (N0/N3).

Returns, per node, ``degree``, ``closeness``, ``eigenvector``, ``betweenness``,
``pagerank``, ``harmonic``, ``constraint`` (Burt), ``effective_size`` (Burt),
``bridging`` (normalised betweenness) and ``clustering``, plus ``community_id``.
The graph-level ``global`` block carries ``assortativity``. When the slice is
larger than the approximation threshold the ``betweenness``/``bridging`` scores
are k-sampled and the response is flagged ``approximate: true``.

Mirrors the scope parsing of ``/network/graph`` so the centralities always
describe exactly what is on screen.

post.description:
Clear Circuit Breaker state (all sessions, or a single ``key``).

Use this to recover immediately if a breaker is stuck OPEN and you have reason
to believe the session is healthy again (e.g. you rotated a proxy). The breaker
re-learns health from subsequent requests.

Force-terminate every pending/running job and recycle the worker pool.

Jobs blocked on a stalled yt-dlp/network call cannot be cancelled
cooperatively (cancellation is only honoured at unit boundaries), so
this marks them terminal and abandons their worker threads, unblocking
the queue. Intended as an explicit operator escape hatch.

Declared before ``/jobs/{job_id}`` so the static path wins over the
``{job_id}`` path parameter for POST requests.

client connects with ``EventSource`` and reconnects automatically.

AdvancedSamplingSpec.title: AdvancedSamplingSpec
AdvancedSamplingSpec.description:
Advanced sampling specification for cross-channel, multi-video, and user-based sampling.

Supports complex researcher scenarios:
- Sample/population of specific user comments across all videos and channels
- Sample/population within specific channel(s)
- Sample/population of specific users with their IDs
- Sample/population of non-specified users across one channel but among specified videos
- Video filters within same channel (date range, type, duration, views, etc.)
- Multiple channels among specific period
- Combination of channel IDs, video IDs, author IDs with sampling strategies

AuthorCommentCount.title: AuthorCommentCount
AuthorCommentCount.description: Comment counts for one distinct author.

ChannelFacet.title: ChannelFacet
ChannelFacet.description: A distinct channel observed on the network slice (id + name).

ChannelGraphEdge.title: ChannelGraphEdge
ChannelGraphEdge.description:
One channel-projection edge: weighted aggregation of video edges A->B.

``video_edge_count`` counts the underlying video-level edges;
``sample_video_pairs`` holds the first few ``{source_video_id,
recommended_video_id, position}`` pairs as evidence.

ChannelGraphNode.title: ChannelGraphNode
ChannelGraphNode.description:
One channel-projection node (doc ``analysis_next_layer_scrape.md`` §4.2).

``video_count`` counts the distinct videos of this channel in the slice;
``in_degree``/``out_degree`` count distinct channel neighbours; provenance
(``run_ids``/``run_types``) mirrors ``GraphNode``.

ChannelGraphPayload.title: ChannelGraphPayload
ChannelGraphPayload.description:
Channel-projection graph payload (doc §4.2).

``channels`` carries the ``ChannelFacet`` list plus ``unattributed_edges``
in a facet's metadata dict when present (edges dropped because either
endpoint's channel could not be resolved are counted, never synthetic).

ChannelHistoryPoint.title: ChannelHistoryPoint
ChannelHistoryPoint.description: One channel observation with per-step growth vs the previous one.

ChannelProjection.title: ChannelProjection
ChannelProjection.description:
Lightweight channel-level projection (documented in the module doc).

``channels`` lists the distinct channels observed on edges (with their
resolved names when a ``Channel`` row exists) and ``edge_count`` counts
the edges carrying a channel attribution.

CohortBody.title: CohortBody
CohortBody.description: A named cohort: optional channel scope plus an optional VideoFilter.

CohortChange.title: CohortChange
CohortChange.description: Between-cohort percent change of a metric mean (previous -> current).

CohortComparison.title: CohortComparison
CohortComparison.description: Named cohorts compared by video count and metric means.

CohortSummary.title: CohortSummary
CohortSummary.description: One cohort: video count and per-metric mean/median.

CollectionSpec.title: CollectionSpec
CollectionSpec.description:
A configurable, reproducible collection experiment.

Every criterion may be left unset; unset values fall back to the module
defaults (via :meth:`effective`) so the resolved configuration is always
visible and auditable.

CollectionTarget.title: CollectionTarget
CollectionTarget.description: One collection target (channel, video, or recommendation source).

ColumnCoverage.title: ColumnCoverage
ColumnCoverage.description: Missing-value statistics for one column of a dataset's stored rows.

CombineDatasetsRequest.title: CombineDatasetsRequest
CombineDatasetsRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../datasets/combine`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Combines multiple datasets into a new dataset, optionally deduplicating
members and preserving lineage (which original dataset each member came from).

CommentTreePayload.title: CommentTreePayload
CommentTreePayload.description: Full comment tree with nested replies for a root comment.

ComparisonMetricRow.title: ComparisonMetricRow
ComparisonMetricRow.description:
One (entity, metric) cell of a comparison table.

``value`` is the raw latest-observed value; ``normalized`` is the value
after the chosen normalization; ``percentile_rank`` ranks the normalized
value within the compared set; ``is_outlier`` flags ``|z| > 3``.

ComponentSummary.title: ComponentSummary
ComponentSummary.description: One connected component of a layer's new-edge subgraph.

sampling_fraction.title: Sampling Fraction
sampling_fraction.description: Computational pair-sampling fraction (5%/10%/20% typical). NOT a claim of statistical representativeness.

max_pair_cap.title: Max Pair Cap
max_pair_cap.description: Hard cap on sampled pairs per pair-selection operation (never exceeded).

num_permutations.title: Num Permutations
num_permutations.description: Community-label permutation count for the null model.

max_videos_per_community.title: Max Videos Per Community
max_videos_per_community.description: Replacement-sampling limit per community when transcripts are missing.

max_transcript_videos.title: Max Transcript Videos
max_transcript_videos.description: Hard cap on UNIQUE videos for transcript/embedding collection in a single analysis. Selection picks a balanced, community-representative set of at most this many videos (prioritising those with existing transcripts) and samples pairs only from them, so collection never exceeds this budget. The dominant, rate-limited cost (YouTube 429s) is therefore bounded independently of the pair count.

include_edge_similarity.title: Include Edge Similarity
include_edge_similarity.description: Optional separate recommendation-edge semantic similarity (kept distinct from community-level homophily).

ContentHomophilyStartRequest.title: ContentHomophilyStartRequest
ContentHomophilyStartRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/content-homophily`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Opt-in, on-demand CONTENT evidence over ANY network scope: ``run_id``
pins the analysis to one run's slice, ``video_ids`` to an explicit set;
with neither, the whole persisted recommendation network is analyzed.
Transcript collection is targeted at the sampled videos only.

CoverageReport.title: CoverageReport
CoverageReport.description: Snapshot of dataset completeness at a point in time.

CreateDatasetRequest.title: CreateDatasetRequest
CreateDatasetRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../datasets`` (``extra="forbid"``).

When ``project_id`` is set the dataset is built from the project's research
query and variable selection; otherwise a plain dataset snapshots the whole
``entity_type`` population. ``entity_type`` is the corpus slice in both
cases and is only optional when the project's research query names it.

Dataset.title: Dataset
Dataset.description:
A materialized, immutable row set built from the corpus.

``member_count`` mirrors the persisted member rows; ``overflow`` is ``True``
when the members needed more than one storage chunk (see ADR-0001 / the
~32k Excel cell limit implemented in :mod:`persistence.dataset_repository`).

DatasetExportPayload.title: DatasetExportPayload
DatasetExportPayload.description:
Documentation-only response model for the streaming export endpoint.

The route actually streams the dataset bytes via ``StreamingResponse``;
this model exists so the route still satisfies the API contract gate that
every route declares a ``response_model``.

DatasetMemberRow.title: DatasetMemberRow
DatasetMemberRow.description: One member row projection (columns vary per dataset; extras allowed).

DatasetQualityReport.title: DatasetQualityReport
DatasetQualityReport.description:
Dataset quality report: per-column missing-value matrix plus coverage.

``corpus`` embeds the reused ``QualityService.dataset_summary()`` snapshot
so the dataset-level numbers sit next to the corpus-level ones.

DegreeDistribution.title: DegreeDistribution
DegreeDistribution.description: Percentile summary of a directed degree distribution.

projection.title: Projection
projection.description: Which node type the chamber analysis runs over: the seed video's recommendation graph of videos, or the channel-level graph (communities/concentration measured on channels).

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Researcher labels applied to the job and its runs.

EchoDetectRequest.title: EchoDetectRequest
EchoDetectRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../echo-chamber/detect`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Identifies the seed (``video_url`` | ``video_id`` | ``seed_run_id``) and
the crawl budget. ``collect_comments`` opts in to comment collection so
the S5 commenter-overlap signal can be observed.

EchoDetection.title: EchoDetection
EchoDetection.description: The full detection record: spec + append-only timeline + latest score.

EdgeRow.title: EdgeRow
EdgeRow.description:
One serialized recommendation edge for listing / export.

Carries metadata for BOTH endpoint videos so the UI can render composite
labels (``[ID] + Channel Name + Video Title + metrics``) without a second
round-trip. Target fields also fall back to the observation row's own
``title``/``channel_id`` (populated at scrape time).

EntityComparison.title: EntityComparison
EntityComparison.description:
Comparison table for a set of videos or channels.

``population_size`` is the number of table cells requested (entities x
metrics); ``n`` is the number of cells with an observed (non-``None``)
value. Absence therefore counts toward the population, never hidden.

EntityRunDelta.title: EntityRunDelta
EntityRunDelta.description: Per-entity diff between two run snapshots.

ExistingVideoEntry.title: ExistingVideoEntry
ExistingVideoEntry.description: One existing video referenced by the layer (classification info).

ExpansionActionPayload.title: ExpansionActionPayload
ExpansionActionPayload.description:
API serialization of a network-expansion action anchor.

An expansion action reuses the :class:`LayerRun` store with
``config_json["expansion"]`` marking the kind / filters / auto-project; the
payload flattens those fields for the UI.

ExpansionOverallStats.title: ExpansionOverallStats
ExpansionOverallStats.description: Overall (global) statistics over an expansion action's subgraph.

ExpansionScrapeAllRequest.title: ExpansionScrapeAllRequest
ExpansionScrapeAllRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/expansion/scrape-all``.

One-hop expansion of the current network slice: either an explicit
``video_ids`` list or a ``run_id`` whose videos/sources form the scope.

ExpansionScrapeVideoRequest.title: ExpansionScrapeVideoRequest
ExpansionScrapeVideoRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/expansion/scrape-video``.

One-hop expansion of a single video; ``filters`` controls what is scraped
from its recommendations.

ExpansionStats.title: ExpansionStats
ExpansionStats.description: Overall + per-video stats for one network-expansion action.

ExploreResult.title: ExploreResult
ExploreResult.description: Paginated explorer page for one entity.

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest
ExportRequest.description:
Request to export selected data to Excel.

Provide ``entity_type`` (+ optional ``ids``/``columns``) for a single-entity
sheet, or ``project_id`` to export *everything a project collected* as a
multi-sheet workbook (Videos, Comments, Channels, Recommendations, Runs).

ExportResponse.title: ExportResponse
ExportResponse.description: Response for export endpoint (file download handled separately).

GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge
GraphEdge.description: One enriched graph edge (provenance + role of the recommendation).

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description:
One enriched network node for the interactive graph.

``kind`` describes the node's structural role: ``source`` (out-edges only),
``target`` (in-edges only), ``both`` or ``other``. ``runs``/``run_types``
list the provenance of the edges touching this node.

JobComparison.title: JobComparison
JobComparison.description: Two jobs compared via their aggregated child-run metrics.

JobResultPayload.title: JobResultPayload
JobResultPayload.description: Union-shaped job result (single result, many results, or failure).

JobSnapshot.title: JobSnapshot
JobSnapshot.description:
Aggregated snapshot of one collection job's child runs.

``entity_counts`` sum the distinct entities observed across the job's
child runs (a video seen in two child runs counts once); ``metrics``
pool every child-run observation into one mean (never an average of
averages).

LayerBootstrapRequest.title: LayerBootstrapRequest
LayerBootstrapRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/layer`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Creates the seed ``LayerRun`` (layer 0) from an existing run whose videos/
sources become the crawl frontier.

LayerFrontier.title: LayerFrontier
LayerFrontier.description: The frontier of a layer (drives the layer stepper UI).

max_recommendations_per_video.title: Max Recommendations Per Video
max_recommendations_per_video.description: Optional cap on how many recommendations to keep per frontier video (speeds up wide crawls). Omit for no per-video limit.

discovery_mode.title: Discovery Mode
discovery_mode.description: How the resolved frontier is crawled. 'rescrape_known' (default, the historical behaviour) re-observes every resolved frontier video's recommendations even if that feed was already scraped earlier in this crawl family. 'frontier' skips videos whose recommendations were already observed anywhere and only scrapes genuinely unexplored nodes.

LayerScrapeRequest.title: LayerScrapeRequest
LayerScrapeRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/layer/scrape`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Either ``parent_layer_run_id`` (advance an existing crawl) or a seed
``parent_run_id`` (start layer 1) is required. ``projection`` selects the
graph view; ``collect_comments`` toggles comment enrichment for new videos.

MergedDegreeNode.title: MergedDegreeNode
MergedDegreeNode.description:
A top-degree node of a merged network with resolvable labels.

Follows the module's label-hygiene rule: a bare video id is never shown
without context, so titles/channel names are resolved from persisted
repositories when available (``None`` only when nothing was persisted).

MergedGraphStats.title: MergedGraphStats
MergedGraphStats.description:
Combined SNA statistics over the union of two scopes.

Mirrors ``NetworkMetrics`` so the merged-graph report reads like any other
network slice, plus ``top_degree_nodes`` (labeled, deterministically
ordered by total degree then id).

MergedNetworkResult.title: MergedNetworkResult
MergedNetworkResult.description:
Overlap report + merged SNA stats for two network scopes.

``nodes``/``edges`` carry the enriched union graph (labels resolved, same
shape as ``NetworkGraph``) so the UI can render the merged net, while
``overlap`` answers "how much do these two nets share?".

MetricDelta.title: MetricDelta
MetricDelta.description: Absolute change and growth % for one metric between two runs.

MetricStat.title: MetricStat
MetricStat.description: Mean/median of one metric over an entity set with provenance.

NetworkExportToProjectRequest.title: NetworkExportToProjectRequest
NetworkExportToProjectRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/export-to-project`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Serializes a scoped video network (graphml/edgelist/gexf/csv/json) and
persists it as a :class:`ProjectItem` artifact under a Project. With no
scope the whole persisted recommendation network is exported.

NetworkGraph.title: NetworkGraph
NetworkGraph.description:
Full graph payload: enriched nodes + edges + run/channel facets.

Served by ``GET /network/graph`` so the UI renders readable nodes
(``[ID] + Channel Name + Video Title + metrics``) and populates the
run/channel filter dropdowns from real facets - never from the rendered
graph.

NetworkMergeOptions.title: NetworkMergeOptions
NetworkMergeOptions.description:
Picker payload for ``GET /network/merge/options``.

Lists the run and expansion-action scopes the UI can merge. Videos are
intentionally omitted (could be huge); the video-ego scope is entered as
free-form ``video_ids``.

NetworkMergeRequest.title: NetworkMergeRequest
NetworkMergeRequest.description:
Body for ``POST .../network/merge`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Merges two scoped video networks and reports the overlap (shared
nodes/edges, Jaccard) plus combined SNA statistics on the union graph.

NetworkMetrics.title: NetworkMetrics
NetworkMetrics.description: Aggregate statistics for one recommendation-network slice.

NetworkScope.title: NetworkScope
NetworkScope.description:
A video-network scope for export / merge operations.

``run_id`` pins the slice to one collection run; ``run_ids`` pins it to a
set of runs (a network-expansion action's runs); ``video_ids`` keeps only
the ego edges touching any of the listed videos. When every field is empty
the scope is the whole persisted recommendation network.

NetworkScopeRequest.title: NetworkScopeRequest
NetworkScopeRequest.description:
A video-network scope (``extra="forbid"``).

``run_id`` pins the slice to one collection run, ``action_id`` to a
network-expansion action (its runs), ``video_ids`` to the ego edges
touching any listed video. An empty scope = the whole persisted network.

NetworkScrapeChannelRequest.title: NetworkScrapeChannelRequest
NetworkScrapeChannelRequest.description: Bulk scrape of every known video belonging to a channel.

NetworkScrapeRunRequest.title: NetworkScrapeRunRequest
NetworkScrapeRunRequest.description: Bulk re-scrape of every source video observed in one run.

NetworkScrapeVideoRequest.title: NetworkScrapeVideoRequest
NetworkScrapeVideoRequest.description: Click-to-scrape one video node from the network tab.

NetworkSlice.title: NetworkSlice
NetworkSlice.description: NetworkSummary-like snapshot for a single run.

NewChannelEntry.title: NewChannelEntry
NewChannelEntry.description: One newly discovered channel in a NewRelationsReport.

NewRelationsReport.title: NewRelationsReport
NewRelationsReport.description:
The "what did this crawl add?" classification report (doc §5.4).

``counts`` is authoritative; every list is capped so a large layer does
not produce a megabyte response (caps documented per field).

NewVideoEntry.title: NewVideoEntry
NewVideoEntry.description: One newly discovered video in a NewRelationsReport.

Normalization.title: Normalization
Normalization.description: Explicit normalization applied to every compared metric.

ObservationPoint.title: ObservationPoint
ObservationPoint.description: One observation in the entity's history (most recent first, bounded).

Operator.title: Operator
Operator.description: Binary and rank operators understood by the query evaluator.

OperatorInfoPayload.title: OperatorInfoPayload
OperatorInfoPayload.description: One operator understood by the research query evaluator.

OverlapStats.title: OverlapStats
OverlapStats.description:
Shared/exclusive node & edge counts between two network scopes.

``jaccard_*`` is ``None`` when the union is empty (no meaningful ratio),
never fabricated as 0. Edge identity is directed (``source->target``).

PairwiseOverlap.title: PairwiseOverlap
PairwiseOverlap.description: Overlap statistics for one pair of samples (key ``a|b`` with a<b).

ParticipationAnalytics.title: ParticipationAnalytics
ParticipationAnalytics.description: Unique vs repeat author participation over a video's comments.

PeriodChange.title: PeriodChange
PeriodChange.description: Between-period percent change of a metric mean (previous -> current).

PeriodComparison.title: PeriodComparison
PeriodComparison.description: Two upload-date periods compared per metric with growth deltas.

PeriodSummary.title: PeriodSummary
PeriodSummary.description: One upload-date (or joined-date) window and its metric stats.

Project.title: Project
Project.description:
A persisted ResearchProject design (ADR-0002 Phase D).

``targets`` items are ``{"kind": ..., "url": ...}`` dicts; the research
query is the ``{"entity", "root", "query_context"}`` shape of
``domain.query.ResearchQueryRequest.model_dump()``. ``config_hash`` is a
stable sha256 over the mutable definition (``ProjectService.config_hash``)
and changes only when the researcher edits the design.

ProjectItem.title: ProjectItem
ProjectItem.description:
A project item that groups related samples and datasets for a research project.

A project item can contain multiple samples and datasets, allowing researchers
to organize their work into logical units (e.g., "Pilot Study", "Main Analysis",
"Replication"). Each item tracks its constituent samples and datasets with
provenance information.

ProvenanceRecord.title: ProvenanceRecord
ProvenanceRecord.description: The provenance chain of a single entity.

QueryCondition.title: QueryCondition

QueryContext.title: QueryContext
QueryContext.description: Optional scope for a research query (which subset of the corpus).

QueryGroup.title: QueryGroup
QueryGroup.description:
A node in the research query tree.

``operator`` is ``"AND"``/``"OR"``/``"NOT"``. Members are conditions or
nested groups; ``NOT`` negates the conjunction of its members.

QueryPreviewStage.title: QueryPreviewStage
QueryPreviewStage.description:
A single funnel stage: cumulative = rows matching the prefix so far,
matched = incremental drop caused by adding this condition.

RawRecordPayload.title: RawRecordPayload
RawRecordPayload.description: The sanitized source payload behind one persisted record.

ReplyMetrics.title: ReplyMetrics
ReplyMetrics.description: Reply-rate and thread-size structure of a video's comments.

RunComparison.title: RunComparison
RunComparison.description: Run-snapshot comparison with entity churn between runs.

RunDeltaReport.title: RunDeltaReport
RunDeltaReport.description: Snapshot diff of two runs of the same type.

RunSnapshot.title: RunSnapshot
RunSnapshot.description: Observation-count snapshot of one collection run.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: Provenance-relevant fields of one collection run.

RunTransition.title: RunTransition
RunTransition.description: New / disappeared entities between two consecutive runs.

RunType.title: RunType
RunType.description: The kind of target a collection run is executed against.

RunVideosPayload.title: RunVideosPayload
RunVideosPayload.description: Paginated list of videos collected in a run.

Sample.title: Sample
Sample.description:
An immutable, persisted research sample (ADR-0011).

``sample_id`` is stable forever; there is deliberately no update endpoint.
``member_ids`` holds the full ordered membership (reassembled from the
chunked sidecar when ``overflow`` is true), and ``criteria_json`` records
the exact criteria so the sample can be audited and reproduced.

The ``labels`` field supports three namespaces:
- ``system``: auto-populated provenance (created_at, created_by, source_corpus, collection_run_id)
- ``research``: researcher-defined design metadata (research_question, methodology, population, sampling_frame, notes)
- ``custom``: arbitrary key-value pairs created by the researcher

The ``scope`` field tracks the data-space boundaries of this sample
(channel_ids, video_ids, author_ids, date_from, date_to) for reproducibility.

SampleCompareRequest.title: SampleCompareRequest
SampleCompareRequest.description:
Body of ``POST {prefix}/samples/compare``.

``metrics`` is accepted up front as a forward-compatible dimension for
future metric-level comparison; it is echoed back verbatim today.

SampleCompareResult.title: SampleCompareResult
SampleCompareResult.description:
Response of ``POST {prefix}/samples/compare``.

``counts`` is per-sample membership; ``intersection_size`` counts members
shared by *all* compared samples; ``criteria_diffs`` lists, per sample, the
criteria fields (strategy/seed/hash/population size/criteria JSON) that
differ from the first sample in the request.

SamplingSpec.title: SamplingSpec
SamplingSpec.description:
Reproducible sampling criteria.

``seed`` makes random/stratified samples reproducible; ``criteria_json``
records the exact criteria used so the sampling is transparent.

max_recommendations_per_video.title: Max Recommendations Per Video
max_recommendations_per_video.description: Keep only the top-N recommendations per feed

ScrapeFilters.title: ScrapeFilters
ScrapeFilters.description:
What a network-expansion scrape should collect from the recommendations.

Request-side (``extra="forbid"``). Defaults mirror the click-to-scrape
behaviour: collect comments, skip already-observed edges, deep-enrich only
videos the corpus does not know yet, project onto the video graph.

SessionContext.title: SessionContext
SessionContext.description:
Active workspace + project/dataset selection plus last-update timestamp.

``active_workspace_id`` is stored OUTSIDE any per-workspace session file
(a workspace cannot contain the pointer to itself): it lives in the root
``workspaces/active.json`` document managed by :class:`WorkspaceService`.

SessionContextPatch.title: SessionContextPatch
SessionContextPatch.description:
Body for ``PUT .../session/context`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Only explicitly provided fields are applied; ``{"active_project_id": null}``
clears that field without touching the other one. Setting
``active_workspace_id`` performs a full workspace activation (one code
path with ``POST /workspaces/{id}/activate`` semantics).

SortOption.description: One sortable variable exposed to the explorer UI.

TargetKind.title: TargetKind
TargetKind.description: The kind of target a collection experiment collects from.

TemporalGrowth.title: TemporalGrowth
TemporalGrowth.description: Delta between two consecutive requested runs.

ThreadSizeBreakdown.title: ThreadSizeBreakdown
ThreadSizeBreakdown.description: One comment thread (root plus its descendant replies).

UpdateProjectRequest.title: UpdateProjectRequest
UpdateProjectRequest.description:
PATCH body for ``PATCH .../projects/{project_id}`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Only explicitly provided fields are applied (pydantic ``model_fields_set``
semantics); sending ``research_query: null`` clears the query.

UpdateRunRequest.title: UpdateRunRequest
UpdateRunRequest.description:
Body for ``PATCH .../runs/{run_id}`` (``extra="forbid"``).

Only explicitly provided fields are applied; editable fields are the
researcher-provided ``name`` label and ``tags``.

UpdateWorkspaceRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceRequest
UpdateWorkspaceRequest.description:
PATCH body for ``PATCH .../workspaces/{workspace_id}``.

``model_fields_set`` semantics like the session patch: absent fields stay
unchanged. ``is_legacy`` is immutable by construction (not patchable).

VideoFilter.description:
Filter for selecting videos of a channel corpus.

View-based filters apply to the *latest* observation of each video at the
time the filter runs - never to fabricated historical values.
